final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark AS original_order_reference, AVG(remaincount) AS group_average FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.original_order_reference, s1.group_average, s1.group_average - s2.overall_average AS step3_difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.group_average > s2.overall_average), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.group_average, s3.step3_difference, s3.group_average - s4.overall_average AS step5_difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s4.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.group_average > s4.overall_average) SELECT AVG(group_average), AVG(step3_difference), AVG(step5_difference) FROM step5
